correctness.rationale: The 24-vertex LCF graph was reconstructed independently. It has 36 edges, exactly 32 distinct seven-cycles (a complete cyclic-order-normalized enumeration), vertex incidence at most 10, hence no triple can hit all 32. Exhaustive 10,626 four-subset tests return precisely the 16 four-pair choices plus four specified exceptional sets. Exactly 32 one-exchange edges form a four-cube and four isolates. Independent BFS verifies girth exactly 8 after each of these 20 deletions and girth 7 after all 2,024 triple deletions. Finite exhaustive enumeration is a complete proof for this fixed graph, not sampling.
